title: 10 Areas of Society To Work In
paragraphs: I'm going to give everybody a job now. Ready? Write it. Get a pen. This is yourjob. Find one of these areas to work in. I call them the pillars of influence inyour society. Number one, politics. Go into government. Number two, economics. Go into the world of money. Numberthree, business. Go into commerce and influence thatworld for Jesus in the kingdom. Number four, judicial. Go into law and become alawyer, young man. That area needs the kingdom. Number five, health.

Go intothe health care system and bring the kingdom there. Don't go work for money. Work for influence. Number six, education. Go and impact the training of the minds of the future. Those kids are sopliable. We need kingdom people in the classroom cuz right now we got devils inthe classroom. Don't complain. Go in the classroom. The world number seven of arts, entertainment. Go into music and actingand drama. That's the world. You got to go into that world. Andnumber eight, recreation, the world of sports.

Go be an athlete. Join afootball team or become a part of the of the ice hockey. IN OTHER WORDS, GETINVOLVED. YOU SAY, "WELL, I know I'm a Christian. I can't play hockey." Oh, shut up, man. Go into the world of hockey. And some of you parents need to repent. Keeping your kids out of these worlds. They must go into those worlds AND IMPACT IT FOR JESUS. Bring the kingdomto those worlds. Number nine, the world of media. Boy, this a serious one.

That's why the media is destroying nations because the saints ain't in themedia. They lock you out. I want you to go ahead and learn how to be a good anchor woman, an anchor manfor the news. They don't know who you are until it's too late. You got yeastsitting in front of the TV. And you choose the stories that you read. And they're not all murder, but you got to be in there to do that. So go into media, young woman, youngman, go ahead and be an anchor. Be the the weathermanand put on one of the pins.

Let me tell the camera this is a specialweather pin. Number 10, the pillar of social impact. That means all the social sciences, welfare, sociology, social work, communitybuilding. These are worlds. We need the kingdom in every pillar.
